review.review_note: Verified against official NHLBI sources. Atherosclerotic plaque buildup in the large coronary arteries is identified as the leading cause of coronary heart disease. Plaque accumulation narrows coronary arteries and reduces blood flow to the heart muscle. NHLBI explicitly identifies coronary artery disease as an alternative name for coronary heart disease, resolving the terminology concern. The CAUSES relationship is medically supported. Plaque buildup is the leading cause but not the only possible mechanism. No correction required.

review.review_note: NIDDK explicitly identifies high blood pressure as a common cause of adult CKD and states that it can damage renal vessels and filtering structures.
